decision_rule.summary: Selective enzyme-bound-state QSSA (A3a). A complex is ELIMINATED (made algebraic via 0 = dC_i/dt of the author RHS) iff its instantaneous closure defect along the full reference trajectory, normalized by its own production scale and evaluated at post-layer times only, stays at or below the registered screen threshold T_F = 0.01. Otherwise it is KEPT dynamic. Partial elimination is an authorized outcome.
decision_rule.defect_metric: |dC_i/dt| at the reference state divided by sum of production-side fluxes into complex i (author rate laws, audit/reactions.csv rate_law with k1 from audit/parameters.csv); never normalized by net flux
decision_rule.post_layer_window: t >= 5 * tau_fast(enzyme), tau_fast = max over derivation samples of tau_from_slowest_attracting_s in aminoacylation_v1_qssa_relaxation.csv

MetRS_MettRNAfMetCAU.note: formylation-coupled product complex; drains with MettRNAfMetCAU over t~4-12 s; O(1) defect is a genuine slow-mode signature, not numerical

outside_pool.free_enzyme_reconstruction: MetRS and GlyRS (free forms) remain DYNAMIC states in the author RHS; no explicit pool-total substitution is made (A2 reporting variables are derived downstream, the DAE never reparameterizes the author model)
outside_pool.all_other_species: unchanged dynamic states (241 total states; 21 algebraic, 220 dynamic)
outside_pool.formylation_subsystem: untouched; MettRNAfMetCAU and all FMet_tRNASynthesis species remain dynamic and couple the networks

verification_required_before_freeze: aminoacylation_v1_partition_* artifacts: algebraic well-posedness (nonsingular eliminated-block Jacobian), branch uniqueness under multi-start, attractivity, frozen-slow relaxation, and branch-vs-reference occupancy distance for the 21-eliminated subsystem

evidence.start_agreement: <=3.5e-14 relative to pool wherever >=2 starts converged
evidence.max_scaled_algebraic_residual: <=1e-10 by construction of convergence test; final residuals <=1e-13 observed
evidence.spectrum: all 12/12 (MetRS) and 9/9 (GlyRS) eliminated-block modes attracting at every sample; the non-attracting mode of the FULL 14-dim block at t=1e-4 disappears once the slow kept complexes are removed from the algebraic block - direct confirmation that the kept states carry the slow directions
evidence.relaxation: 30/30 perturbations reach the branch; worst 1%-time 0.032 s; deepest negative excursion -1.2e-24 (round-off level, recorded not clipped)
evidence.post_layer_branch_reference_match: max per-complex |C_branch - C_ref|/e_pool <= 1.12e-3 at all post-layer samples (threshold 0.01); t=1e-4 and MetRS t=5.7e-3 fall inside the registered [t0, t0+5*tau_fast] initial-layer window and are scored by the layer rules instead

verification_result.scoring_window_update: formal-run layer windows use the RESTRICTED-block tau_fast above (5*tau <= 0.049 s), superseding the conservative full-block values used for the screen
